output.notes: Block_ops describe one decoder layer of the base config (post-LN, causal self-attn, cross-attn, ReLU FFN); encoder layer is the same without the cross-attention and without the causal mask. Embedding scale 22.627417 = sqrt(512) for base (32 for big). Big config head_dim left not_stated: table leaves d_k blank ("identical to base", i.e. 64) but the row has no number. Vocab 37000 is for EN-DE BPE; EN-FR uses 32000 word-pieces. Attention scale 0.125 = 1/sqrt(64). Bias of attention projections, LayerNorm eps and max context length are not stated. Learned positional embeddings (row E) and attention-over-parameters are rejected variants, not described.
